option.name: --allow
tip: Allow only the given hosts to connect.

option.name: --allowfile
tip: Read allowed hosts from a file.

option.name: --append-output
tip: Append to output files instead of overwriting them.

option.name: --broker
tip: Enable connection brokering.

option.name: --chat
tip: Start an ad-hoc chat server.

option.name: --crlf
tip: Use CRLF for the EOL sequence.

option.name: --delay
tip: Wait between read and write operations.

option.name: --deny
tip: Deny the given hosts.

option.name: --denyfile
tip: Read denied hosts from a file.

option.name: --exec
tip: Execute the given command after a connection is established.

option.name: --help
tip: Display the help screen and exit.

option.name: --hex-dump
tip: Dump session data as hex to a file.

option.name: --idle-timeout
tip: Set the idle timeout.

option.name: --keep-open
tip: Accept multiple connections and keep the listener open.

option.name: --listen
tip: Listen for incoming connections.

option.name: --lua-exec
tip: Execute the given Lua script after a connection is established.

option.name: --max-conns
tip: Set the maximum number of simultaneous connections.
The default is 100 (60 on Windows).

option.name: --no-shutdown
tip: Do not shut down into half-duplex mode after EOF on stdin.

option.name: --nodns
tip: Do not resolve hostnames via DNS.

option.name: --output
tip: Dump session data to a file.

option.name: --proxy
tip: Connect through the given proxy.

option.name: --proxy-auth
tip: Set the proxy credentials.

option.name: --proxy-dns
tip: Control where proxy destination hostnames are resolved.
Possible values: local, remote, both, none.

option.name: --proxy-type
tip: Set the proxy protocol.
Possible values: http, socks4, socks5.
Only http is supported in listen mode.

option.name: --recv-only
tip: Only receive data, never send.

option.name: --sctp
tip: Use SCTP.

option.name: --send-only
tip: Only send data, never receive.

option.name: --sh-exec
tip: Execute the given command via /bin/sh after a connection is established.

option.name: --source
tip: Set the source address to bind to.

option.name: --source-port
tip: Set the source port.

option.name: --ssl
tip: Use SSL.

option.name: --ssl-alpn
tip: Set the ALPN protocol list.
Accepts a comma-separated list.

option.name: --ssl-cert
tip: PEM certificate file used to authenticate the server or client.

option.name: --ssl-ciphers
tip: Set the OpenSSL cipher list.

option.name: --ssl-key
tip: PEM private key file matching the certificate.

option.name: --ssl-servername
tip: Set the TLS SNI server name.

option.name: --ssl-trustfile
tip: PEM file containing trusted certificates.

option.name: --ssl-verify
tip: Verify server certificates.

option.name: --telnet
tip: Answer Telnet negotiations.

option.name: --udp
tip: Use UDP.

option.name: --unixsock
tip: Use Unix domain sockets.

option.name: --verbose
tip: Increase verbosity.
Can be repeated for more detail.

option.name: --version
tip: Display the Ncat version and exit.

option.name: --vsock
tip: Use AF_VSOCK sockets (Linux only).

option.name: --wait
tip: Set the connect timeout.
Use IPv4 only.
Use IPv6 only.

option.name: -g
tip: Set IPv4 loose source routing hops.
Can be given multiple times or with a comma-separated list.

option.name: -G
tip: Set the IPv4 source routing pointer.
Possible values: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28.

option.name: -q
tip: Wait the given time after EOF on stdin, then quit.

option.name: -z
tip: Zero-I/O mode: report connection status only.
